notes: Gross HP through 1972: IH's 1972 Scout II literature still quotes gross (111/150/193.1/196.7). SAE net from 1973 (Hagerty) and in all IH literature found for 1975-1980. All IH brochures count as one source. Hagerty repeats one rating per engine across 1976-80 that conflicts with IH spec tables; IH figures are recorded as hp. V-392: never offered in the Scout. The IH 1971 brochure lists it for pickups only, and no source lists it for the Scout. 6-258 after 1972 unconfirmed; absent from IH 1975/76/78/79/80 Scout literature. Generations: 1961-65 Scout 80; 1966-68 Scout 800 (late-1965 '1965 1/2' builds exist); Nov 1968-1970 800A; Aug 1970-Mar 1971 800B; Scout II from Apr 1971 (1971 MY). gen 'scout800' covers 800/800A/800B. Terra/Traveler 1976-80 and SSII 1977-79 share Scout II engines (SSII 1979 brochure: 4-196, V-304, V-345 only).
